name: Akiza Valentine
source: Witch. She has an online business making potions in the traditional way, with handmade tools. She gets along very well with her sisters, but she wants to show that despite being the youngest, she is not inferior to the rest of them. She is very lazy and doesn't like to exercise, although she joins the gym just to see muscular and handsome men, because deep down she is a pervert.
